version.summary: Windows beta with verified native engines, build hardening, and password-confirmed workspace protection changes.
notes: New: remove workspace password protection from Settings → Security → View all workspaces → Unsecure. Your current password is required; documents and saved work are kept. Protection is shared across workspace folders.
English to and from Arabic, and English to and from Urdu, translated on your own computer
One-step first-run setup: all language models and OCR install together, then verify themselves
Stamp feature (signature stamp, company seal, logo) and text or image watermarks with opacity, rotation and repeat-across-the-page
Export a PDF as the Layout version, a Text-only version, or both
Review panel: click an issue to jump to it, then fix, retry, ignore or mark reviewed
Support codes (FLC-xxxx) with a Diagnostics page and a redacted support bundle
Word (.docx) support in the Linux and Windows packages
Unsigned installer: Windows may display a SmartScreen warning (see the install guide)
Hardened Windows build: control-flow guard, address-space randomisation and data-execution prevention, checked in the build
Fixes: a malformed licence file can no longer crash the app; archive extraction has size limits; scratch files are private to your account
Fix: English to Urdu on Word (.docx) and Excel files now produces Urdu (it produced Arabic in an earlier build)
Windows installer validation passed: desktop startup, Word/Excel, PDF rendering, CPU translation, OCR, model preservation on reinstall, and binary hardening.
